plan.title: M5Stack Cardputer-Adv · K132-Adv
plan.summary: 带56键键盘与小型LCD的ESP32-S3便携开发设备，提供音频、IMU、存储卡和扩展接口。
limitations: Only manufacturer exterior geometry is imported; board, display, keyboard, touch and RF runtime unavailable.
No physical hardware measurement performed; official photographs may include shipping films and uncalibrated perspective.
PCB is an explicitly estimated UNKNOWN placeholder without invented components or traces.
Source CAD does not supply calibrated material properties; colors are source-photo-informed display approximations.
Sticker masks retain only documented white paper. Shell gray, screws, keys and LCD are never projected. Paper perimeter/position remain image measurements +/-0.25mm.
plan.assemblyNotes: Components 0/2/3/6/9/10 share assembled coordinates. Others are translated duplicate printing parts. Common -90 degree Z rotation and -0.8mm Z translation only. Source width 84.06984 and max depth 19.67563 differ from one-decimal 84.0/19.6 targets; predeclared 0.1mm reporting tolerance, no geometry correction.

textureSources.notes: Only left ADV white paper and four keyboard legend white strips. Alpha is zero on LCD, black keycaps, screws, module and every gray shell area. Explicit ROI mask, not brightness threshold.
Only irregular white factory back sticker; screw circles and gray molded shell/nameplate are excluded. Exact outer-plane-only decal.

facts.label: Exterior sticker surfaces
facts.method: Manufacturer face-normal/centroid-area audit identifies outer planar faces; explicit pixel polygons isolate white paper. Whole triangles must match a single exteriorZ plane within0.005mm.

facts.label: Rear CARDPUTER wordmark
facts.value: Manufacturer CAD contains shallow molded/engraved letters on the rear shell below the paper. No photograph is mapped to this plastic region; the lettering remains shell-colored and may have low contrast under frontal lighting.
facts.method: Untextured rear CAD remains lettered in original and gold oblique renders; the alpha ROI excludes the full molded nameplate region. No duplicate printed glyphs added.

facts.label: 56-key exterior geometry and host mapping
facts.method: Exterior cap triangles reach viewerZ>6.5mm;56 disconnected groups are sorted top-to-bottom and left-to-right using their measured bounds. Full cap triangles and the untouched carrier partition cover the original39168faces once. Host codes match primary printed keys and official modifiers; AltRight for Fn is an explicit platform convention, not a manufacturer HID code.
